title: ServiceInstance
description: An SAP HANA Cloud service instance representing a provisioned database with its configuration, status, and connection details.

id.description: The unique identifier assigned to the service instance during provisioning.

name.description: The user-defined name of the SAP HANA Cloud service instance, used for identification in the cockpit and API responses.

service_plan_id.description: The identifier of the service plan used to provision this instance, determining the available features and resource tiers.

platform_id.description: The platform identifier indicating the runtime environment (e.g., cloud-foundry or kubernetes).

context.description: Platform-specific context information including subaccount, organization, and space details.

labels.description: Key-value labels assigned to the instance for organization and filtering purposes.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the service instance was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the service instance was last updated.

ready.description: Indicates whether the service instance is fully provisioned and ready for use.

usable.description: Indicates whether the service instance is currently usable, accounting for both provisioning state and operational status.
